source_policy: Only repository code, tests, generated evaluation artifacts, and successful GitHub Actions are treated as evidence.

items.claim: The final score uses six explicit weighted subscores.
All automated tests pass locally and in GitHub Actions.
The synthetic evaluation fixture contains 36 jobs and 3 resumes.
The reproducible local evaluation completed in approximately 0.17 seconds on the development machine.
Advice output separates evidence-backed edits from skills that may only be added after real work.
